evidence: The body resolves/reads indexed values and conditionally routes them through helper calls, but the exact result and semantic contract are unclear without callers or stronger callee labels. decompiled/main/main_0089.c:29707-29809.

Returns small status codes after checking a record value and related global value, then querying context selector 0x14 and status predicates; no caller indexed. decompiled/main/main_0089.c:26770-26852.

Branches on context selector 0 status, either collects helper values for qualified entries or fetches selectors 1 and 2, passes the resulting stack values and count to a helper, then dispatches event 0x1020ef0d and conditionally sets a global flag. decompiled/main/main_0086.c:12038-12113.

For records with tag 0x1a and a successful eligibility check, iterates up to 30 entries, compares loaded record values and applies helper updates; chooses adjustment selector based on a record field and thresholds 4, 7, and 10. decompiled/main/main_0058.c:45703-45763.

When a context predicate succeeds, looks up a record field, maps values 1 through 6 through a six-entry table, defaults to zero outside the range, and stores the result; otherwise leaves output initialized to UINT32_MAX. decompiled/main/main_0124.c:30014-30050.
